name: Behringer JN-80 (NRPN, 12-bit)
description: Behringer JN-80 8-voice analog polyphonic synthesizer: its quick start guide's controllers, with the twenty its NRPN table gives sent as those NRPNs at 12 bits (0 - 4095).

sources.title: JN-80 Quick Start Guide
sources.notes: MIDI controller table (page 12) read by tools/profiles/behringer/read-behringer-cc.mjs from QSG_BE_0722-AAP_JN-80_WW.pdf (sha256 7599e90c275bb49a7005d4278337d57aa467cd0ea64af6ddba0bfe9e8719c195), https://cdn-media.empowertribe.com/b22341b3f2674b608b4db82af7af6523/QSG_BE_0722-AAP_JN-80_WW.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/behringer/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/behringer/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the guide's MIDI controller table, with its printed name, sent as a control change on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Ranges are as printed (`0 - 99`): the guide does not say whether a range is the controller's values or what the panel shows for them.

The twenty parameters of the guide's NRPN table (`The JN-80 responds to and transmits the following MIDI NRPNs`) are sent as those NRPNs, 0 - 4095, the number on CC 99 and 98 and the value on CC 6 and 38 (the guide's `NRPN Data MSB` and `LSB`): the value's high 7 bits on CC 6, as data entry carries 14 bits. The guide does not say how the 12 bits are split, so that is the MIDI convention, not the guide. Every other parameter is the controller the JN-80 profile sends.
The JN-80 profile is the same instrument at 7 bits on every controller; use one or the other.
Rows the guide prints wrongly, given by the layout: CC 16 (printed VCF Resonace).
Hex column misprints, the decimal taken: CC 36 printed 23, CC 37 printed 24.

Left out, the wheels, pedals, bank select, NRPN and RPN controllers and the channel mode messages: CC 0 Bank select, CC 1 Mod Wheel, CC 6 NRPN Data MSB, CC 11 Expression, CC 38 NRPN Data LSB, CC 64 Sustain pedal, CC 66 Sostuento pedal, CC 69 Sustain pedal, CC 96 NRPN Data increment, CC 97 NRPN Data decrement, CC 98 NRPN Param LSB, CC 99 NRPN Param MSB, CC 120 All sounds off, CC 123 All notes off.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers when its MIDI settings allow
